purpose: Test whether historical dual-response sensitivity candidates remain physically stable and useful when entire calendar-date blocks are withheld. Full-sample bootstrap alone is not sufficient for publication.

condition_snapshot_binding.reason: The source CSV has no historical condition_snapshot_version/condition_label binding. Current yyq_SO2 fixed-grid coordinates are reconstructable, but historical final condition labels are not invented.
condition_snapshot_binding.publication_rule: This audit cannot itself create a runtime HistoricalSensitivityMap. Canonical HistoricalEpisodeEngine output must be used for snapshot/context-bound retraining before publication review.

audit_event_extraction.action_boundary: xstgjb_APL > 1 Hz, with a new segment also forced by timestamp gap > 20 s
audit_event_extraction.delta_q_definition: median actual supply flow during pump-active segment minus median actual supply flow during 10-minute pre-window
audit_event_extraction.response_definition: 13-17 minute post-action-start median minus pre-action median
audit_event_extraction.grid_definition: current plant yyq_SO2 fixed grid, 500-5000 mg/Nm3 in 100 mg/Nm3 steps
audit_event_extraction.warning: These are observational operator interventions. This extraction is used to audit temporal robustness; it does not prove a randomized causal derivative.

blocked_validation.holdout_leakage_policy: No event from a holdout calendar date is used in that fold's fit.

review_thresholds_audit_only.note: These thresholds are explicit audit review criteria, not hidden plant/runtime defaults.

ladder: GRID_SCALAR: no work-point interaction; nuisance adjustment retained
GRID_INLET_PH_SURFACE: delta-Q x inlet-SO2 and pH interactions
model_complexity_policy.reason: Within-grid continuous response surfaces are allowed only when date-blocked evidence supports them. Exact-state lookup is still forbidden; a validated scalar grid prior plus neighbor interpolation is a valid online mapping model.

scalar_grid_results.reason: SO2 channel is temporally stable but pH channel is not. Dual-response publication therefore fails.
SO2 reaches the audit direction threshold, but pH changes sign across held-out date blocks. The previous full-sample P13 review candidacy must not be promoted.
P14 is the strongest individual grid, but event-weighted pH holdout direction is only 70%, below the 80% dual-channel audit threshold.

decision.online_mapping_implication: Exact context/grid profiles remain preferred when they later pass blocked validation. Until then, a reviewed pooled fallback may initialize low-confidence MFAC state while Dynamic Qbase remains fully independent. No exact-state history match is required.

required_next_steps: Run the same blocked validator on canonical HistoricalEpisodeEngine output with real condition_snapshot_version and mfac_context_id binding.
Do not publish P13/P14/P15 from the earlier full-sample audit; blocked validation has downgraded them.
Review pooled scalar fallback confidence and snapshot binding separately before creating any runtime HistoricalSensitivitySurface.
Accumulate additional historical/online evidence for per-context dual-channel stability; pH is currently the limiting channel in several grids.
Only increase within-grid model complexity when the simpler model has passed and the more complex model improves blocked validation without degrading physical direction.
